title: Sr. Cloud(AWS) Engineer
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, secure, automate, and operate our AWS-based cloud platform supporting a mission-critical oncology software solution used by patients, clinicians, and healthcare organizations worldwide.  
  
This role is responsible for both cloud infrastructure engineering and DevOps practices, ensuring our SaaS platform is secure, scalable, highly available, and compliant with healthcare and medical device requirements. The successful candidate will work closely with software engineering, architecture, security, quality, and operations teams to enable reliable software delivery and operational excellence.  
  
This is a hands-on technical role requiring deep expertise in AWS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, cloud security, observability, and production operations.  
  
The product is Siemens Healthineers´s cloud-based software solution for patient relationships and care navigation management. It’s designed to connect cancer patients with their clinics online throughout the entire cancer journey. The product used by 35 000+ active cancer patients and healthcare professionals from leading oncology centers in North America and Europe. The candidate in this role will provide strong product development leadership to a team of software engineers and test engineers, working in an agile/scrum environment.

**Job Description**

**Position Duties:**

* Design, implement, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure supporting production and non-production environments.
* Develop cloud architectures that meet requirements for scalability, availability, security, performance, and disaster recovery.
* Manage AWS services including compute, networking, storage, databases, identity management, and monitoring.
* Optimize infrastructure utilization, cloud costs, and operational efficiency.
* Implement multi-region and high-availability solutions where appropriate.
* Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and operational best practices.
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines enabling secure and reliable software delivery.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployment processes.
* Ensure platform availability, reliability, and performance through proactive monitoring and automation.
* Utilize AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and development productivity.
* Lead incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.
* Implement and maintain observability solutions including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions.
* Automate provisioning, configuration management, deployment, monitoring, and recovery processes.

**Qualifications Required:**  
BE, MSc, MCA, Computer Science or related discipline.

**Number of year’s related experience** 8-10 years
  
  
**Special Knowledge / Skills:**  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps (Development, Security and Operations), Site Reliability Engineering, or platform engineering roles.
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience supporting production SaaS environments.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages.
* Experience with container technologies and orchestration platforms.
* Strong understanding of security concepts (Cloud security architecture, network security, encryption and key management, vulnerability management, IAM etc.)
* Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or New Relic
* Experience with Terraform or Infrastructure as Code

**Nice to have:**

* Experience developing healthcare products conforming quality system regulations.
* Certifications from AWS or Azure
* Understanding of healthcare data security and privacy requirements
* Experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools through coursework, personal projects, or internships.

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work**: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

**Data Privacy**: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

**Beware of Job Scams:** Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

**To all recruitment agencies**: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

title: Salesforce BAU Support Analyst, Team Lead
description:
**Job Summary**

  

We are seeking a proactive Salesforce BAU Support Analyst with 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise Salesforce environments. The role is responsible for day-to-day platform support, production issue investigation, user assistance, minor enhancements, data operations, access administration, and coordination with business and technical teams. The successful candidate will help maintain platform stability, meet service expectations, and improve the user experience through timely and well-documented support.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Production & BAU Support**

* Provide day-to-day functional and technical support for Salesforce users and business teams.

* Triage, investigate, resolve, and track incidents, service requests, defects, and user queries.

* Analyze reported issues, identify root causes, document findings, and coordinate permanent fixes.

* Monitor support queues and ensure tickets are updated, prioritized, and resolved in line with agreed service levels.

* Escalate high-impact or complex issues to Salesforce developers, administrators, architects, or integration teams.

**Salesforce Administration**

* Support user onboarding, offboarding, access changes, password resets, roles, profiles, permission sets, queues, and public groups.

* Maintain standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and email settings.

* Assist with Salesforce Flow monitoring and basic configuration updates following approved change processes.

* Investigate login, visibility, sharing, data access, and permission-related issues.

**Data Support & Reporting**

* Perform approved data loads, updates, exports, cleansing, and validation using Salesforce data tools.

* Investigate data-quality issues, duplicates, missing values, ownership concerns, and integration discrepancies.

* Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards for support tracking and business reporting.

* Validate data before and after deployments, releases, and production fixes.

**Release & Change Support**

* Participate in impact analysis, testing, regression validation, UAT support, deployment readiness, and post-production checks.

* Coordinate minor enhancements and configuration changes with development, QA, DevOps, and business teams.

* Maintain implementation notes, release evidence, support procedures, and rollback or recovery information.

* Follow enterprise change-management, security, risk, and compliance controls.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, known-error records, and standard operating procedures.

* Identify recurring incidents and recommend automation, process, configuration, or training improvements.

* Communicate clearly with stakeholders regarding ticket status, business impact, dependencies, and resolution.

* Support periodic platform health, access, audit, and data-quality reviews.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce administration, application support, production support, or BAU operations.

* Strong understanding of Salesforce objects, relationships, security, sharing, profiles, permission sets, reports, dashboards, and data management.

* Experience handling incidents and service requests through Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or a comparable ticketing platform.

* Working knowledge of Salesforce Flow, validation rules, approval processes, Data Loader, and data import/export activities.

* Ability to investigate issues using configuration review, user access checks, debug information, and structured root-cause analysis.

* Experience supporting testing, deployments, release validation, and post-production activities.

* Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder-management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to manage competing priorities and provide support within a controlled enterprise environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Certified Administrator certification.

* Experience with Financial Services Cloud or Salesforce solutions used in financial-services environments.

* Familiarity with integrations, APIs, scheduled jobs, ETL processes, and middleware support.

* Knowledge of ITIL practices, including incident, problem, service-request, and change management.

* Exposure to Salesforce sandboxes, metadata deployments, Git, Copado, Gearset, Salesforce DevOps Center, or comparable tools.

Experience supporting audit evidence, access reviews, security controls, and regulated business processes.  

  

**Key Competencies**

  

* Customer-focused support

* Incident triage & resolution

* Salesforce administration

* Data quality & reporting

* Root-cause analysis

* Release and UAT support

* Process documentation

* Stakeholder communication

  
  

**Certification Preferred:** Salesforce Certified Administrator.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description: Principal Engineer, Data Platform (Databricks)**

**About the Role**

We are building our next-generation data platform on Databricks. The Principal Engineer sets the technical direction for how the bank ingests, models, governs and serves data. This is a hands-on role: you will design the detailed lakehouse implementation, set engineering standards for SQL and pipelines, lead the migration from legacy platforms, and mentor engineers across several teams. You will work within the target-state architecture owned by the Solution Architect.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lakehouse design:** Own the detailed design of the Databricks lakehouse: ingestion, bronze/silver/gold layers, Delta Lake design, Unity Catalog setup, and workspace and cluster configuration.
* **Migration:** Lead the hands-on migration of legacy Hadoop/Hive/Spark and warehouse workloads to Databricks, including re-platforming HQL and SQL, validating data parity, and safe cutover.
* **Engineering standards:** Set standards for SQL, PySpark and Delta Live Tables/Lakeflow pipelines, covering code review, testing, CI/CD and observability.
* **Performance and cost:** Tune performance and cost: partitioning, liquid clustering/Z-ordering, file compaction, join and shuffle tuning, Photon, cluster right-sizing and DBU spend governance.
* **Data modeling:** Design canonical, auditable entity models (applications, accounts, customers, transactions) across source systems.
* **Security and compliance:** Implement PII protection, encryption and tokenization, row/column-level security, lineage, retention and audit readiness with Security, Risk, Compliance and Data Governance.
* **Design reviews:** Lead technical design reviews, write architecture decision records, and resolve cross-team technical trade-offs.
* **Mentoring:** Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and raise engineering quality across the data organization.
* **Data products:** Work with Analytics, Data Science/ML, Risk, Fraud and Finance to turn business needs into reliable, documented data products.
* **Evaluation:** Evaluate new Databricks capabilities and tools and recommend adoption where there is clear value.

**Must-Have Skills**

* **Experience:** 12+ years in data or software engineering, with at least 5 years in a technical lead, staff or principal role.
* **SQL:** Expert-level SQL: complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs, query plan analysis and tuning on very large datasets (billions of rows).
* **Spark and big data:** Deep experience with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala) and the ecosystem: Hadoop, Hive, Kafka, Parquet/ORC/Delta.
* **Databricks in production:** Hands-on production use of Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows/Jobs, Databricks SQL, and cluster and cost management.
* **Pipelines:** Proven design and operation of large-scale batch and streaming pipelines, including Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables and Kafka, on a major cloud.
* **Migration:** Experience migrating on-premises or EMR-based Hadoop/Hive platforms to Databricks.
* **Performance and cost:** Proven Spark and Databricks performance tuning and cost optimization, including cluster policies.
* **Data modeling:** Dimensional, entity-centric, Data Vault or medallion modeling, including slowly changing dimensions, incremental/CDC loads and soft deletes.
* **Orchestration and CI/CD:** Airflow, Databricks Workflows or Oozie; Git, Terraform or Databricks Asset Bundles, and automated testing and data quality checks.
* **Data security:** Implementation of PII protection: encryption, tokenization, and row/column-level security.
* **Leadership and communication:** Mentoring engineers, and explaining technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and executives.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Banking, lending or other regulated financial services experience
* Data modeling for Marketing (campaign, attribution, funnel) and Collections (delinquency, contact, payments)
* Observability and monitoring frameworks for data pipelines
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional

title: Senior Associate - .Net Engineer
description:
### **Description**

As a Senior Associate - .NET at Davies, you will be a key contributor to the design, development, and maintenance of our software applications across the enterprise. You will work within a Scrum Agile framework, helping define technical standards, driving engineering excellence, and guiding the team towards modern, scalable, test‑driven development practices. This role will see you innovating with modern technologies — including C#, .NET Core, React, Azure, microservices, and containerisation — while mentoring colleagues, partnering with architects, and shaping best practices across the organisation. You will play a critical role in delivering high‑quality, secure, and resilient services that underpin Davies’ operational platforms and client‑facing systems.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Software Design & Development**  

* Lead the development of secure, high‑quality applications using C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, and modern JavaScript frameworks (React preferred).
* Design, develop, and maintain microservices, APIs, and event‑driven architectures.
* Apply SOLID principles, design patterns, and engineering best practices across solutions.
* Ensure reliable production performance through modern site reliability engineering approaches.

  
**TechnicalLeadership & Mentoring**  

* Provide technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to less experienced engineers.
* Champion Test Driven Development (TDD), automated testing, and continuous delivery.
* Lead the team in adopting modern engineering techniques, tools, and frameworks.
* Support peers in writing maintainable, clean, and scalable code.

  
**Collaboration & Technical Partnerships**  

* Work closely with architects to evolve frameworks, patterns, and reference architecture.
* Collaborate with product, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless delivery pipelines.
* Engage with third‑party software vendors across design, development, and support lifecycles.
* Partner with cloud engineering teams to deliver scalable Azure‑based solutions.

  
**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**  

* Experiment with emerging technologies and propose improvements to engineering practices.
* Contribute to architectural discussions, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards.
* Support the evolution of secure coding standards and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive automation across testing, deployments, and environments.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

  

* Strong experience in **C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, Entity Framework**.
* Skilled in **React** (or Angular/Vue) and modern JavaScript practices.
* Experience building **microservices**, event‑driven systems, and distributed architectures.
* Cloud experience with **Azure Functions, Azure components** (or AWS/GCP equivalents).
* Strong understanding of **TDD**, unit testing, automated testing frameworks.
* Proficiency in **CI/CD pipelines**, DevOps tools, and secure coding practices.
* Solid understanding of **RESTful APIs and Web APIs**.
* End‑to‑end ownership of feature development from technical design through to deployment.
* Contribution to and compliance with engineering standards, frameworks, and code quality expectations.
* Support and maintenance of key applications within the Davies estate.
* Leadership of technical initiatives that uplift team capability and maturity.
* Active participation in Agile ceremonies and sprint planning.
* Consistent delivery of secure, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

This role shapes the end-to-end design and delivery of resilient cloud-native data platforms and microservices. You’ll set technical direction across modernisation of legacy estates while staying close enough to the code to unblock teams and strengthen engineering quality in Java and distributed system design. The focus spans high-performance data pipelines, event-driven integration and production-ready operational standards in a regulated environment. Success means services that are scalable, observable and secure with clear roadmaps that reduce risk and disruption to live operations. You’ll influence senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into pragmatic technical plans and measurable milestones.

What you'll be doing

* Own solution architecture for high-performance data pipelines and microservices including resilience, scalability, latency, observability and security
* Define modernisation roadmaps across re-platforming, refactoring and microservices decomposition with minimal disruption to live services
* Establish engineering standards for API design, event-driven integration, data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD and operational readiness
* Manage technical debt through clear prioritisation and measurable outcomes
* Architect, design and build core services using Java (8+), Spring Boot 3, JPA and PostgreSQL (or other RDBMS) using event streaming patterns
* Deliver real-time processing implementations using Apache Flink and/or Apache Beam where appropriate
* Partner with engineers on code reviews, pair debugging, performance tuning and production incident resolution
* Own operational excellence on GCP across monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, reliability improvements and cost optimisation

What we're looking for

* Bring substantial software engineering experience designing and delivering distributed systems and data-intensive applications
* Demonstrate recent hands-on Java engineering expertise using Spring Boot with REST and event-driven services
* Apply proven system design across microservices patterns, asynchronous messaging, idempotency, consistency models, caching, rate limiting and failure handling
* Show strong SQL capability including performance tuning and working effectively with ORM frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate
* Deliver cloud-native solutions on GCP or an equivalent cloud platform with the ability to translate patterns and services
* Troubleshoot across application, data, infrastructure and performance layers to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence
* Communicate architecture decisions clearly and connect them to business priorities and operational constraints
* Coach and mentor engineers across levels to strengthen craftsmanship, accountability and continuous improvement

Building resilient data services

If you want to shape modern cloud-native platforms while staying hands-on with Java engineering this role offers real scope to make a visible difference. You’ll set direction for microservices and data pipelines that need to perform under demanding production conditions. The work spans architecture, delivery and operational excellence so improvements show up in reliability, scalability and engineering efficiency. If this aligns with the kind of platform work you want to own we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

title: Platform Customer Engineer, Manufacturing and Conglomerates
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
* Experience translating customer objectives into integrated cloud solutions across multiple domains.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
* Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, or penetration testing).

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: SENIOR CONSULTANT
description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

  

With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

  

**About Atos Group**

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

**Job Description**

  

**Role summary**: Migrate existing Lambda/Dagster/dbt pipelines onto a Glue‑based, Redshift‑centric medallion architecture (S3 Bronze Redshift Silver Gold canonical model), embed data quality, lineage, security and CI/CD controls into every pipeline, and mentor engineers through domain‑by‑domain migration waves

  

**Key responsibilities**

* Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
* Design and build Glue‑based ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
* Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
* Build automated data‑quality gates, reconciliation checks, and source‑to‑report lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of business‑critical reports
* Implement IAM, AWS‑native encryption, Secrets Manager and Gold‑layer RBAC/least‑privilege access.
* Establish Dev/Test environments, Git‑based CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
* Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
* Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
* Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

  

**Mandatory skills**

* 10+ years in data engineering, 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
* Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
* AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and hands‑on medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
* AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
* Python (primary) — PySpark for Glue jobs.
* MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
* DBT— must be able to read, reverse‑engineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
* Data‑quality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
* Git, CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
* Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

  

**Nice to have**

* Dagster orchestration — for AS‑IS discovery and migration.
* Kafka / event‑driven streaming ingestion.
* Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
* Tableau, Metabase serving‑layer knowledge.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Data‑governance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).
* UK financial‑services experience: IFRS 9, BCBS 239, FCA/PRA reporting, UK GDPR.
* Preparing governed datasets for AI/ML use cases.

title: Technology Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Technology Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
  
**Must have skills :** SAP BTP Application Development  
**Good to have skills :** Python (Programming Language), Node.js  
Minimum **18** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
The SAP Business AI Development Manager leads the design, engineering, and delivery of responsible, scalable AI solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP). The role combines hands-on SAP architecture and development expertise with engineering leadership, delivery governance, and stakeholder management. The manager will embed AI and generative AI capabilities into enterprise processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP Concur, supply chain, spend, and customer-experience solutions while maintaining clean-core, security, privacy, and responsible-AI standards.  
SAP BTP Development Manager  
  
SAP Business Technology Platform ,AI Engineering ,Generative AI ,Enterprise Application Development  
  
Role: SAP BTP & Business AI Development Manager, Architect  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Solution strategy and architecture: Define solution approaches and reference architectures for embedded and side-by-side AI extensions on SAP BTP, balancing business value, scalability, security, maintainability, and clean-core principles.  
Engineering leadership: Lead multidisciplinary teams of AI engineers, SAP BTP developers, data engineers, integration specialists, and quality engineers plan capacity, allocate work, remove delivery impediments, and coach team members.  
AI Foundation delivery: Govern development using SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, and the generative AI hub, covering experimentation, model selection, deployment, inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.  
Generative AI adoption: Establish standards for prompt engineering, prompt lifecycle management, model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, grounding, and rapid prototyping.  
Business-process integration: Embed capabilities such as intelligent document processing, natural-language interfaces, workflow automation, recommendations, forecasting, and decision support into SAP and non-SAP processes.  
Application development: Oversee SAP CAP, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, SAP HANA Cloud, Cloud Foundry, and Kyma-based development, including APIs, events, integrations, and reusable services.  
AI-assisted engineering: Guide responsible use of Joule for Developers and SAP Build Code for code scaffolding, explanation, refactoring, test generation, and review support.  
Quality and DevSecOps: Ensure AI-generated and developer-created artifacts are reviewed, validated, tested, secured, traceable, and approved before release drive CI/CD, observability, automated testing, and production-support practices.  
Responsible AI and governance: Implement controls for privacy, security, transparency, content safety, bias mitigation, human oversight, model risk, auditability, and regulatory compliance throughout the AI lifecycle.  
Capability building: Create engineering standards, reusable accelerators, reference implementations, and learning plans that strengthen AI, application development, integration, analytics, and data-engineering capabilities.  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Hands-on experience with SAP BTP and relevant services, including SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, the generative AI hub, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Build Code, and SAP Integration Suite.  
Strong knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI observability.  
Proficiency in one or more SAP development stacks: SAP CAP with Node.js or Java, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, REST APIs, and event-driven integration.  
Experience designing cloud-native applications and microservices on Cloud Foundry and,or Kyma,Kubernetes, supported by Git, CI,CD, automated testing, and secure DevOps practices.  
Good understanding of SAP BTP security, including identity and access management, OAuth, role-based access, secrets management, data protection, and secure API design.  
Working knowledge of AI-enabled business processes in SAP S/4HANA and one or more SAP cloud applications such as SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Sales Cloud, or Signavio.  
Demonstrated ability to convert business opportunities into solution designs, delivery plans, estimates, risks, controls, and measurable outcomes.  
Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and delivery ownership.  
Preferred Qualifications  
SAP certification in BTP application development, integration, data, analytics, AI engineering, or a related specialization.  
Experience with SAP Joule Studio and the design or orchestration of AI agents.  
Experience with SAP Document AI, SAP Build Process Automation, Event Mesh, and asynchronous architectures.  
Knowledge of SAP HANA Cloud Predictive Analysis Library, Automated Predictive Library, and vector capabilities.  
Experience integrating models and services from Hyperscaler or SAP AI ecosystem partners through governed enterprise patterns.  
Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated environments with privacy, security, data residency, and compliance obligations.  
Familiarity with responsible-AI frameworks, model risk management, evaluation benchmarks, red teaming, and human-in-the-loop controls.  
Experience creating reusable assets, engineering playbooks, and communities of practice for enterprise AI adoption.  
Leadership Competencies  
Strategic orientation: Connect AI investments to business outcomes, adoption, and value realization.  
Technical judgment: Make pragmatic build, buy, reuse, and integration decisions across SAP and partner services.  
Delivery leadership: Manage scope, quality, schedule, cost, dependencies, and operational readiness across concurrent workstreams.  
Talent development: Build high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing, and structured capability development.  
Executive communication: Explain complex AI concepts, design trade-offs, risks, and value in clear business language.  
Collaboration and ownership: Work effectively across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, legal, risk, and operations teams.  
Measures of Success  
AI use cases delivered on time, within agreed quality and risk thresholds, and with measurable business outcomes.  
Production reliability, security, performance, adoption, and responsible-AI compliance of deployed solutions.  
Reuse of approved architecture patterns, accelerators, components, and engineering standards.  
Improvement in engineering productivity, automated test coverage, release quality, and time to value.  
Stakeholder satisfaction and growth in the capability, proficiency, and retention of the engineering team.  
  
Additional Information:
  
Bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, or a related discipline.  
Typically 10+ years of enterprise application or technology delivery experience, including 3+ years leading SAP BTP, AI/ML, data, or cloud engineering teams.

  
15 years full time education

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**Be part of something bigger!**
--------------------------------

  

As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it’s our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We aim to do this through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low-carbon construction, and green energy.

As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and € 3,7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world!

  

**I. Purpose of the Role**
--------------------------

The Solution Architect – Cloud is responsible for leading the architecture, governance, optimization, and operational oversight of Bekaert's cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure and Alibaba Cloud. The role ensures that cloud services are secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient while enabling business innovation through modern cloud technologies, automation, data, and AI services.
  
As a cloud subject matter expert, the position drives the adoption of enterprise cloud best practices, Azure Landing Zones, cloud governance frameworks, FinOps disciplines, monitoring and observability standards, and cloud security controls. The role provides technical leadership for cloud transformation initiatives, application modernization, AI-enabled solutions, and platform engineering capabilities across the organization.
  
The <POSITION\_TITLE> collaborates closely with business stakeholders, application teams, security teams, architecture teams, and strategic service partners to define cloud standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and ensure successful delivery of cloud solutions aligned with Bekaert's business objectives.

**II. Roles and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

**Cloud Architecture & Design**
  

* Design, implement, and optimize enterprise-scale cloud architectures on Azure and Alibaba Cloud.
* Through understanding of Azure landing zones, Azure AI Landing Zones, subscription structures, networking, security, and governance frameworks.
* Architect highly available, resilient, and scalable solutions for business-critical applications.
* Lead cloud modernization and migration initiatives from on premises to cloud.
* Review application onboarding requirements and provide cloud architecture recommendations.

**Cloud Operations & Support**
  

* Ensure platform availability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Comprehensive knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) practices, including incident, problem, change, and capacity management.

* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities and implement preventive measures.
* Define and maintain operational standards, runbooks, and SOPs.

**FinOps & Cost Optimization**
  

* Monitor cloud consumption and spending across Azure and Alibaba Cloud environments.
* Implement FinOps practices for chargeback/showback and budget management.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities through Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot VMs, and resource optimization.
* Build cloud cost dashboards and executive reports.
* Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to forecast and manage cloud budgets.

**Monitoring & Observability**
  

* Define SLIs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Implement proactive monitoring, logging, and automated remediation.

**Cloud Security & Governance**
  

* Well experience with cloud security best practices and compliance requirements.
* Manage IAM, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and security policies.
* Experienced with - Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy and Alibaba Cloud Security Center.
* Conduct security assessments and remediation activities.
* Support audits and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Networking & Connectivity**
  

* Hands experienced with :- VNets, VPCs, Private Endpoints, VPN Gateways, ExpressRoute, Load Balancers, Application Gateways & DNS Services.
* Troubleshoot network performance and connectivity issues across hybrid environments.

**Automation & DevOps**
  

* Strong experience with developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using: Terraform, Bicep & ARM Templates.
* Automate operational processes using: PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python & Bash.
* Support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Implement platform automation and self-service capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management**
  

* Collaborate with application teams, security teams, vendors, and cloud providers.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship as and when required.
* Support cloud strategy discussions and technology roadmaps.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**III. Skills & Competencies**
------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, or Cloud Architecture.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native services.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, landing zones, and enterprise-scale cloud deployments.
* Experience designing and governing Azure Landing Zones, subscriptions, management groups, and policies.
* Expertise in cloud networking including VNets/VPCs, ExpressRoute, VPN, Private Endpoints, DNS, Load Balancers, and hybrid connectivity.
* Strong knowledge of cloud security, identity, access management, RBAC, PIM, and governance frameworks.
* Experience in Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Security Center, and compliance controls.
* Proven experience in cloud operations, service management, and operational governance.
* Strong understanding of ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Experience leading major incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and service improvement initiatives.
* Strong experience with monitoring, observability, logging, and alerting solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Workbooks and CloudMonitor and Azure & Alibaba native backups and HA/DR strategies.
* Experience in FinOps, cloud cost optimization, budgeting, forecasting, and cloud financial management.
* Knowledge of Azure Reservations, Savings Plans, Azure Hybrid Benefit, and resource optimization strategies.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, or Bash scripting.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of containerization and modern application platforms such as AKS, Container Apps, App Services, and Functions.
* Experience supporting cloud migration, modernization, and transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and resilience strategies.
* Ability to define cloud standards, architecture patterns, governance controls, and best practices.
* Experience managing and governing services delivered by external vendors and managed service providers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage technical and business audiences.
* Ability to provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance across cloud initiatives.
* Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Administrator, Terraform Associate, or Alibaba Cloud certifications are preferred.

**Be bold and take the leap!**
------------------------------

  

Our Digital Advanced Solutions (ADS) team is a dynamic group of technologists from around the globe who consistently push boundaries in digital innovation, cyber resilience, data science, intelligent automation, cloud solutions, and new agile methodologies.
  
It is also good to know tht at Bekaert, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Want to learn more about our digital opportunities? Visit Bekaert Careers

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer with strong AWS, automation and production engineering experience to help design, build and operate secure, resilient and scalable cloud platforms.

You will work closely with software engineering, architecture, security and operations teams to improve service reliability, automate infrastructure and operational processes, strengthen observability and resilience, and support enterprise applications across development, test and production environments.

* Design, provision and maintain secure and scalable AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code best practices.
* Build and operate AWS environments using services such as Amazon EC2, EKS, S3, RDS, ALB/NLB, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, SNS/SQS, AWS Backup and Secrets Manager.

* Strong practical experience with Terraform and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon EKS, Kubernetes, Docker and Helm.
* Experience building and maintaining enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong understanding of AWS networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups, load balancers, DNS and private connectivity.
* Good understanding of AWS security, including IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager and least-privilege access controls.
* Hands-on automation and configuration-management experience using Ansible, PowerShell, Bash or similar technologies.
* Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux and Windows Server environments.
* Strong experience with monitoring, logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting and application/infrastructure observability.
* Experience supporting live production services using SRE practices, including incident management, root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews.
* Practical understanding of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, availability, latency, capacity and performance management.
* Ability to analyse operational data and incident trends to prioritise reliability improvements and reduce operational toil.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, application connectivity and CI/CD.
* Good understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, backup and resilient cloud architectures.
* Experience working with Git-based development and infrastructure workflows.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering, architecture, security and operations teams.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with Harness, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Experience with enterprise observability platforms.
* Experience with incident-management and IT service-management processes, including incident, change, problem and request management.

* Experience supporting middleware and data platforms such as Amazon MSK/Kafka, Amazon MQ/RabbitMQ, Redis and PostgreSQL.

* Collaborate with other EDI and integration teams on day-to-day support needs and project-related activities.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science**, Information Technology**, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience.

**Work Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in **EDI / B2B integration implementation, production support, and service operations**.
* Strong hands-on experience with **IBM Sterling B2B Integrator** and/or **Axway B2Bi**.
* Prior experience supporting **Axway-based data exchange environments** is strongly preferred.
* Experience with **Lightwell B2B Framework** is preferred.
* Strong experience handling EDI formats including **ANSI X12** and **EDIFACT**.
* Experience troubleshooting **SAP IDOC** and related data or integration issues.
* Experience supporting and maintaining **business flows, transaction routing, partner connectivity, and production issue resolution** in EDI ecosystems.
* Experience working in a **24x7 production support model** with shift-based operations and escalation ownership.

**Skills and Knowledge**

**Behavioral Skills**

* Critical thinking
* Attention to detail
* Influence and impact

* Interpersonal communication
* Multitasking
* Problem solving
* Time management
* Team guidance and collaboration
* Ownership mindset

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of **ANSI X12** and **EDIFACT** standards.
* Solid understanding of **EDI production support processes**, support structures, incident handling, SLA management, and ticketing tools such as **ServiceNow**.
* Understanding of shared mailbox support, operational queues, and structured triage processes.
* Knowledge of **enterprise application integration** and production data flow dependencies.
* Experience analyzing and reporting **transaction failures, file delivery failures, and data exchange issues**.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and reasoning skills.
* Understanding of **EDI transactions, B2B integrations, business process development, and mapping support**.

* Axway B2Bi and Lightwell B2B Framework.
* Oracle Database.

The individual must be comfortable working in a high-availability support model and participating in major incident response when needed.

This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned EDI professional to take on a lead support role in a complex, high-impact healthcare integration environment. The role offers the chance to work across multiple EDI platforms, engage with global stakeholders, strengthen operational maturity, and contribute directly to the reliability of critical business transactions supporting the US market.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for an experienced Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect to join our India team. As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.  
  
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead cloud solution design during pre-sales engagements: run demonstrations, conduct initial scoping, and architect scalable, secure AWS solutions across Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises.
* Design complex AWS solutions, estimates, and proposals that deliver customer business outcomes, defining project scope and technical approaches for Statements of Work using ProServe offerings and delivery kits.
* Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations while advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders on cloud modernization, generative AI, and agentic AI strategies.
* Ensure smooth hand-offs to Delivery teams so that scope, architecture, and expected outcomes are fully understood at launch, and lead delivery of complex engagements as needed, including migrations, data and analytics, and application development.
* Share knowledge across the organization through mentoring, reusable artifacts, and contributions to ProServe best practices, and represent AWS ProServe at customer events and industry conferences across India.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for a customer's cloud migration, then join a working session with their engineering team to refine a data warehousing solution. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder review presenting progress and recommendations to senior executives. Later, you collaborate with partners and internal teams to scope a new engagement, before wrapping up by documenting reusable patterns from a recently completed project to share across the organization.  
  
About the team  
Our ProServe team in {ADDRESS} works with some of the country's largest Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises to help them realize their cloud ambitions on AWS. You will partner closely with PAEs who own the customer relationship, Delivery teams including Engagement Managers and Delivery Consultants, AWS account teams and Solutions Architects, AWS Specialists including the Generative AI Innovation Center, and AWS Partner Network (APN) partners. Together, this ecosystem turns architectures into measurable customer outcomes.  
  
As an industry subject matter expert, you will help define cloud operating models, drive strategic enterprise transformation, and set up Cloud Centers of Excellence. We are building an inclusive team culture where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. If you want to help shape how India's largest enterprises innovate with the cloud, we would love to hear from you.

------------------------

* 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)

----------------------------

* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* Experience with broad enterprise systems work including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (like TOGAF, Zachman) and identifying the relationships between business services, information, applications and global infrastructure assets
* Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
* Familiarity with the Indian market, digital transformation initiatives (for example Digital India and government cloud policies) and regional compliance requirements (for example RBI, SEBI and IRDAI guidelines, and the DPDP Act)

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Lead to drive the design, development and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI solutions across Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of AskHR, Vodafone’s AI-powered HR assistant, by defining agent architectures, advancing multi-agent orchestration across Google Cloud and Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, and creating reusable AI patterns for broader corporate functions. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering leadership, enabling the delivery of secure, scalable and high-quality AI experiences that enhance employee productivity and experience globally.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Agentic AI Engineering**

* Design, develop and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions, ranging from single-agent implementations to complex multi-agent systems.
* Implement advanced capabilities including tool and function calling, planning, memory management and agent orchestration.
* Apply emerging interoperability standards such as Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

### **Architecture & Knowledge Management**

* Evolve the AskHR AI architecture across Vertex AI Agent Builder, Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine and Gemini, integrating seamlessly with Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Drive improvements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding quality, chunking strategies, metadata filtering and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* Lead the transition from structured workflow-driven experiences to conversational, agent-led interactions.

### **Quality, Security & Operations**

* Establish robust evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, regression testing and conversation analytics.
* Implement observability frameworks, performance monitoring and cost optimisation strategies.
* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy-by-design practices, GDPR compliance, prompt-injection protection and enterprise security controls.
* Define and implement LLMOps practices and CI/CD processes for prompts, agents and knowledge pipelines.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Mentor and support engineers across multiple squads through code reviews, technical guidance and engineering standards.
* Collaborate with architects, conversation designers, product owners and business stakeholders to align technical strategy with business objectives.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and industry developments.

### **Initial Focus Areas**

* Define and secure adoption of a target agentic architecture across HR, Google Cloud, Copilot Studio and SAP platforms.
* Accelerate onboarding of HR journeys and knowledge sources through improved ingestion capabilities.
* Deliver scalable content ingestion pipelines that significantly reduce onboarding time for new data sources.
* Introduce evaluation-led release processes that improve answer quality and user containment rates.
* Prototype innovative employee experiences and contribute to the FY28 AI roadmap.

### **Broader Business Impact**

* Develop reusable agentic AI components, accelerators and reference architectures for HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal and other corporate domains.
* Provide technical leadership across expanding AI portfolios and support the scaling of successful AI solutions throughout the organisation.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in senior software engineering, machine learning engineering or AI platform development, typically gained over 8+ years.
* Proven hands-on experience delivering production-scale generative AI, LLM and agentic AI solutions.
* Strong programming expertise in Python, with TypeScript experience considered advantageous.
* Deep expertise in either Google Cloud AI technologies (Vertex AI, Agent Builder, ADK, Gemini) or Microsoft AI technologies (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework), alongside working knowledge of the alternative ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, API design and enterprise integrations.
* Experience with cloud-native development, including containers, serverless platforms, infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices.
* Expertise in AI evaluation methodologies, observability platforms and production AI monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and supporting the growth of engineering talent.

### **Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Experience delivering AI solutions within HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement or other corporate functions.
* Knowledge of SAP integrations, including SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP.
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms.
* Exposure to multilingual conversational AI solutions, regulated environments and global deployments.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI.
* Relevant Google Cloud or Microsoft certifications.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

Opportunity to define and influence the future state of enterprise agentic AI architecture across a global organisation.Exposure to cutting-edge technologies spanning Google Cloud AI, Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI and multi-agent systems.Collaboration with global AI, architecture, HR and digital transformation teams.Opportunity to drive innovation through proof-of-concepts, experimentation and emerging technology adoption.Ability to create reusable solutions with impact across multiple business functions and global markets.Continuous learning within a rapidly evolving AI and cloud technology landscape.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

Advanced multi-agent architecture design and orchestration.Enterprise-scale implementation of Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).AI governance, responsible AI frameworks and secure enterprise AI deployment practices.End-to-end LLMOps, AI observability and automated evaluation methodologies.Integration of AI agents across SAP, Copilot Studio, Google Cloud and enterprise platforms.Scalable knowledge management, RAG optimisation and conversational AI design techniques.Strategic technology planning and AI portfolio leadership.
