description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Test Lead SME

**In this role, you will:** **(Principal Responsibilities)**

* Act as the senior technical lead for integration testing across the Product Control pod and Channels IT programme.
* Define and own the end-to-end integration-testing strategy across upstream, downstream, internal and third-party systems.
* Establish integration-test scope, environments, test data, dependencies, entry and exit criteria, quality gates and release-readiness measures.
* Lead testing across APIs, microservices, messaging platforms, event-driven services, data pipelines, databases and reporting interfaces.
* Ensure end-to-end business flows are validated across contact center, Product Control, accounting, regulatory and reconciliation processes.
* Coordinate integration testing with global teams across the UK, Hong Kong, Guangzhou, India and Canada.
* Identify and manage interface, environment, data, sequencing and dependency risks.
* Ensure defects are logged, prioritized, root causes are understood and remediation is tracked through to closure.
* Provide clear status reporting on integration coverage, risks, defects, dependencies and release readiness.

**NFR strategy and assurance**

* Define and maintain the NFR strategy, ensuring requirements are identified, measurable, testable and traceable to business and technical outcomes.
* Work with architects, engineers, infrastructure, security, operations and business stakeholders to establish NFR acceptance criteria.
* Lead the planning and execution of NFR testing, including:
* + Performance, load, stress and endurance testing
  + Scalability and capacity testing
  + Resilience, failover and recovery testing
  + Availability and service-continuity validation
  + Data quality, integrity and reconciliation testing
  + Security, access-control and vulnerability validation
  + Monitoring, alerting, logging and observability testing
  + Disaster-recovery and operational-readiness testing
  + Deployment, rollback and production-verification testing
* Define performance baselines, service-level thresholds, capacity assumptions and production-volume scenarios.
* Assess NFR risks and ensure that identified gaps have documented remediation plans and accountable owners.
* Challenge designs and implementation approaches where they may create unacceptable performance, resilience, security or operational risks.
* Produce NFR evidence and sign-off recommendations for governance forums, architecture reviews and release decisions.
* Support audit, regulatory and control requirements through complete and traceable test documentation.

**Technical quality engineering**

* Provide hands-on technical leadership for test automation and integration-validation solutions using Java and relevant testing frameworks.
* Develop and maintain automation for APIs, services, data flows, messaging, database validation and end-to-end scenarios.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish appropriate shift-left quality practices.
* Partner with software engineers to improve service testability, observability, error handling and operational supportability.
* Review test designs, automation code, test results and technical evidence for quality and completeness.
* Support deployment and release activities, including pre-production validation and post-deployment verification.
* Contribute to technical delivery plans, estimates, timelines and sprint planning.

**Architecture and stakeholder management**

* Work with architecture teams to ensure that integration and NFR considerations are embedded in solution designs and aligned with the target-state architecture.
* Translate business and technical requirements into clear integration scenarios and measurable NFR acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream system teams to coordinate interfaces, environments, test data and delivery schedules.
* Communicate technical risks, quality trends and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Manage expectations and negotiate practical compromises while protecting critical quality, control and risk outcomes.
* Support programme governance, release forums, technical design reviews and production-readiness assessments.

**Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and mentor integration-test and quality-engineering colleagues.
* Establish consistent testing standards, reusable approaches and a culture of quality ownership.
* Provide functional management and support the development, performance and career progression of direct reports.
* Contribute to recruitment, resource planning and capability development for the testing function.
* Promote inclusive, collaborative ways of working across geographically distributed teams.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Typically **10+ years’ experience** in software testing, quality engineering, integration testing or software engineering, including significant experience in senior technical leadership roles.
* Proven experience leading integration testing for complex, enterprise-scale and regulated technology environments.
* Strong experience testing distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms and data-intensive applications.
* Demonstrable experience defining and delivering NFR strategies covering performance, scalability, resilience, availability, security, recoverability and operational readiness.
* Hands-on experience with Java and testing frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, Cucumber or equivalent.
* Experience with API and service-testing tools such as REST-assured, Postman, SoapUI or equivalent.
* Experience testing data integrations using relational and NoSQL databases, including data reconciliation, integrity and quality validation.
* Experience with performance and resilience-testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, LoadRunner, Chaos Engineering tools or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of integration patterns, asynchronous processing, messaging, event streaming and distributed data flows.
* Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, SonarQube and Nexus.
* Experience working on Unix/Linux platforms.
* Experience with cloud technologies, containerised platforms and observability tools would be advantageous.
* Experience with data-streaming technologies, such as Apache Beam, would be a plus.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, Scrum, shift-left testing, risk-based testing and continuous testing.
* Experience defining quality gates, release criteria, NFR baselines and production-readiness assessments.
* Proven ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders across multiple locations.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver under pressure.
* A disciplined approach to requirements analysis, test design, risk assessment, defect management and evidence production.
* Degree-level education in software engineering, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Document Controller** in a construction company manages, tracks, organizes, and secures all project-related technical drawings, specifications, contracts, correspondence, and quality records to ensure the right teams use only approved, up-to-date documentation. [1, 2, 3]**Job Title**Document Controller (Construction Project / Site Office)**Job Summary**The Document Controller acts as the central hub for information flow between clients, consultants, main contractors, and internal engineering/site teams. This role prevents costly rework, delays, and compliance issues by enforcing strict version control, standardized naming conventions, and timely distribution of project files. [1, 2]**Key Responsibilities**

* **Standardization & Naming Conventions:** Apply uniform document numbering, metadata tagging, and labeling protocols based on company or project standards. [1, 2]
* **Distribution & Tracking:** Disseminate controlled documents to authorized personnel, track transmittal workflows, and monitor pending review or approval cycles. [1, 2]
* **EDMS & Software Operations:** Manage electronic document management systems (EDMS) and common data environments (CDE) such as Aconex, Procore, SharePoint, or Autodesk Construction Cloud. [1, 2]
* **Compliance & Audits:** Support internal/external audits, ISO 9001 quality management requirements, and project handover documentation packages. [1, 2]
* **Confidentiality & Security:** Implement access control permissions, data backup routines, and secure storage for sensitive or restricted corporate files. [1, 2]
* **Reporting:** Generate periodic document control status logs and progress reports for Project Managers. [1, 2]

**Required Qualifications & Education**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Information Management, Civil/Construction Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 2+ years of experience in document control or project administration within the construction, engineering, or infrastructure sector.
* **Certifications:** Familiarity with ISO standards; specialized training like Certified Document Controller (CDC) or CCDCS is a strong plus. [1, 2, 3, 4]

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* **Software Proficiency:** Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook), PDF editing tools (Adobe Acrobat), and construction platforms like Aconex, Procore, or Asite.
* **Attention to Detail:** High precision in checking revision numbers, stamps, signatures, and metadata.
* **Organization & Multitasking:** Ability to handle high volumes of fast-moving technical submittals under tight project deadlines.
* **Communication:** Clear verbal and written collaboration skills to liaise with site engineers, architects, and external clients. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]

* **Reports to:** Project Manager, Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) Manager, or Operations Manager.

description:
**SOVOS**

**Salesforce Application Architect**
====================================

Accounting/Finance·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity.
* Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales.
* Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access.
* Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder.
* Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy.
* Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design.
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios.
* Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer.
* Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale.
* Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance.
* Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**THE PROCESS**

title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
description:
WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager

**We offer:**
=============

The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.

For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.

For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.

The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.

**Tasks and Qualifications:**
=============================

  

**1. WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%**

* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.

* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.

* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.

**2. WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%**

* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.

* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.

* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.

**3. WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%**

* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.

* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.

* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.

**4. WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%**

* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.

* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.

* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.

* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.

**5. Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%**

* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.

* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.

* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.

* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.

**6. Incident and service-request coordination - 15%**

* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.

* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.

* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.

* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.

**7. Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%**

* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.

* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.

* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.

**8. Operational performance and service improvement - 5%**

* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.

* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.

Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training  

  

Interfaces

Internal:

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers

* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security

* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change

* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management

* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers

* Cloud, datacentre, workplace, decentralised infrastructure and application teams

External:

* Telecommunications carriers and local access providers

* Managed network and security service providers

* Network technology vendors, integrators and professional-services partners

* Auditors and specialist advisers where required

The architect will implement and develop customizations based on functional and technical requirements using leading practices and internal code standards on large-scale more complex professional services projects.

We will provide support and guidance to get you up to speed on some of the most amazing projects! We provide official ServiceNow training so you can achieve multiple certifications. We will set expectations for what success looks like. Then we will allow you use your skills and experience to come up with innovative solutions to achieve customer goals.

We are ***#GoingBeyond*** Come join our crew!

* As a ServiceNow Lead Engineer you will interface with end-users, IT teams and key stakeholders to gather systems requirements for ITOM experience.
* Strong experience with ITOM processes and can guide customers through understanding technical solutions to their business requirements
* You will customize ServiceNow applications and facilitate rollout of new applications, modules, configure Application UI, Workflow, work orders, transfer orders, inventory, and technician locations
* Experience in Flow designer, Business rules, Scripting, Intergrations & Logic implementations
* Configuring integrations between ServiceNow via REST/SOAP web and other applications
* Strong experience with ITOM and can guide customers through understanding technical solutions to their business requirements
* Mentor project crew members by managing peer reviews and provide technical guidance.
* Reflect impact assessment rules within service maps and validate with technical SMEs and stakeholders
* Participate in user acceptance testing of the resulting maps, impact rules and event management work
* Promote your update sets and data across applicable SN environments
* Remediate any production incidents that arise related to this scope
* Align with existing SN technical lead for map/event work to ensure consistent approach that does not break shared patterns
* Proactively maintain operational documentation and SOPs to reduce support risk & inefficiency

**What You Bring Along**

* 5+ years' experience supporting the implementation, administration, configuration, and/or development of ServiceNow in ITOM.
* Experience with integration between ServiceNow and other systems/platforms using both mid servers and cloud to cloud
* Experience working with Web Services Integration (SOAP, REST) and any bi-directional, automated integration between two systems.
* Data Extraction Technologies (e.g. JDBC, ODBC) or ETL integrations
* Knowledge of all aspects of ServiceNow scripting including Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Scripted REST APIs, and Script Includes
* Thrives in strategic planning, resource allocation, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.
* Ability to create technical design documents and user documentation
* Adapts quickly in a fast-paced environment!

**Education:**

* A four-year undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or demonstrated work experience

**Certifications & Knowledge**

The candidate must be willing and able to continue their education within the ServiceNow platform and beyond. It is expected that the candidate will be able to complete ServiceNow competency Certifications as well as Module Accreditations.

*Preferred Certifications:*

* ITIL Foundation
* ServiceNow CSA and CAD

title: Senior Infrastructure / Cloud Engineer
description:

-----------------

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**About the Role**

CBS is seeking a **Senior Infrastructure/Cloud Engineer** to lead the design, automation, and security of our hybrid infrastructure landscape. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep technical expertise across systems administration, networking, Infrastructure-as-Code, container orchestration, and Azure cloud, combined with the ability to mentor junior engineers, drive architectural decisions, and own critical infrastructure and security initiatives end-to-end.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture, administration, and hardening of **Linux and Windows** server environments across the organization.
* Design and govern **network security architecture** — firewalls, forward/reverse proxies, DMZ zones — ensuring alignment with enterprise security standards.
* Lead the development of **Infrastructure-as-Code** standards and reusable **Terraform** modules for scalable, repeatable provisioning.
* Architect and build advanced **Python-based automation** frameworks to reduce manual operations and improve reliability.
* Drive deployment strategy and lifecycle management for applications across environments, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Lead design, scaling, and troubleshooting of **Kubernetes** clusters in production environments, including capacity planning and incident response.
* Own administration and governance of **container registries (Harbor)** — including image lifecycle policies, RBAC, and integration with vulnerability scanning pipelines.
* Architect and manage **Microsoft Azure** infrastructure (networking, compute, storage, identity) with a focus on scalability, cost optimization, and security.
* Lead **vulnerability remediation** initiatives across the estate — including **OS kernel patching** and **Java JDK** version/patch management — establishing proactive patch management processes.
* Drive root-cause analysis for critical infrastructure incidents and lead post-incident reviews.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers.
* Partner with security, application, and DevOps teams to define infrastructure standards, compliance posture, and best practices.
* Evaluate new tools/technologies and make recommendations to improve infrastructure maturity.
* Create and maintain high-quality documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Operating Systems**

* Deep expertise in both **Linux** (RHEL/Ubuntu/CentOS) and **Windows Server** administration, including performance tuning and hardening.

**Networking & Security**

* Strong command of networking fundamentals, **firewalls**, **forward and reverse proxies**, and **DMZ** architecture design.
* Proven experience securing enterprise network environments and troubleshooting complex network issues.

**Automation & Scripting**

* Advanced, hands-on experience writing and architecting **Terraform** modules for multi-environment provisioning.
* Strong proficiency in **Python** for building automation frameworks and tooling, not just scripts.

**Containers & Orchestration**

* Deep, production-grade experience with **Kubernetes** — cluster architecture, scaling, troubleshooting, and operations at scale.
* Proven experience administering **container registries**, particularly **Harbor**, including governance and security integration.

**Cloud**

* Strong, hands-on **Microsoft Azure** expertise across compute, networking, storage, and identity, with experience designing cloud architecture.

**Security & Patching**

* Proven track record remediating **OS kernel vulnerabilities** at scale.
* Strong experience managing **Java JDK patch/version** lifecycles across environments.
* Experience building or improving vulnerability management/patch management processes.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Proven ability to mentor junior engineers and lead technical initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder communication and ability to influence technical direction.
* Excellent documentation and process-ownership skills.
* Ability to work independently and drive projects from design through execution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: **Azure Solutions Architect Expert**, **CKA/CKAD**, **Terraform Associate**, or equivalent.
* Experience in regulated, enterprise, or large-scale environments with strict compliance/security requirements.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) and GitOps practices.
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).
* Prior experience leading infrastructure migrations or cloud modernization projects.

**Experience Required**

* **8–12 years** of relevant experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud engineering, with at least **3+ years in a senior/lead capacity**.

.

Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field required, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, IT infrastructure, or a related field required. Demonstrates advanced capability in a primary technical area (e.g., Windows Server, Linux, VMware) with growing breadth across related domains (e.g., Cloud compute, network infrastructure). Strong structured analysis skills to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex enterprise system outages. Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), VMware Certified Professional (VCP)) preferred.

title: Senior Systems Analyst
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

Specializes in acting as the primary interface between Technology and specific business areas. Identifies and analyzes business needs, conducts requirements gathering, and defines scope and objectives. Makes recommendations for solutions or improvements to business processes that can be accomplished through new technology or alternative uses of existing technology. Specializes in the evaluation of business problems and potential for automated solutions.

* Assists in identifying, evaluating and specification development for systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet requirements.
* Executes unit, integration and acceptance testing for systems that meet business needs.
* Analyzes business reporting, systems data, and relevant performance data to provide business and IT leaders insights to support decision making
* Identifies opportunities for process improvements, systems integration, and technology solutions that address business partner's needs
* CAREER: Applies advanced knowledge of sub-function typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.

**Responsibilities may include:**

* Managing products, systems and/or projects/processes, and working independently with limited supervision.
* Facing IT function related problems that are sometimes difficult and moderately complex.
* Coaching and reviewing the work of lower-level professionals.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* Required Qualifications

  + 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience in enterprise or complex multi-cloud environments.
  + Strong experience administering Salesforce security, user access, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing, object permissions, field-level security, and access troubleshooting.
  + Strong working knowledge of Salesforce configuration, data model management, declarative automation, Flow Builder, validation rules, page layouts, Lightning App Builder, reports, dashboards, and standard platform capabilities.
  + Experience supporting production Salesforce environments, including incident intake, service requests, defect triage, data corrections, release validation, and user support.
  + Experience with data quality management, duplicate management, import/export tools, reporting, audit support, and operational controls.
  + Applied experience or strong readiness to use Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce, Agentforce Vibes, Prompt Builder, Einstein/AI features, AI-assisted configuration, prompt-driven workflows, or comparable enterprise AI tools.
  + Ability to use AI responsibly as an administration and productivity accelerator while validating outputs for data privacy, security, accuracy, business context, governance, and alignment to Gallagher standards.
  + Ability to partner effectively with business stakeholders, developers, architects, QA, DevOps, and support teams to deliver reliable Salesforce capabilities.
  + Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills with the ability to explain platform concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  + Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across India, U.S., and global teams.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Application Development Manager - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Applications Development Senior Manager is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to establish and implement new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to drive applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
1. Strategic Engineering Leadership & Multi-Scrum Governance

* Lead, mentor, and manage multiple cross-functional Scrum teams (Software Engineers, Solution Architects, and QA/Automation Engineers) across globally distributed locations.

* Drive end-to-end delivery accountability across concurrent Books of Work (BOW), ensuring clear milestones, proactive dependency management, and on-time business outcomes.

* Champion engineering excellence, Agile maturity, and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) best practices across all pods under management.

* Conduct personnel management responsibilities including technical coaching, talent acquisition, career development, performance evaluations, and team capacity planning.

**2. Hands-On Technical Authority & Solution Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the senior technical authority for enterprise-scale distributed systems, validating and steering high-level solution designs and low-level architectural patterns.

* Demonstrate active hands-on technical proficiency in **Java 21, Spring Boot 4.x, Cloud-Native Microservices**, and distributed persistence/messaging architectures.

* Establish and enforce rigorous coding standards, design patterns, automated test coverage gates, and continuous code quality reviews (SonarQube, Snyk).

* Drive architectural modernization initiatives, transitioning legacy frameworks into modular, scalable, event-driven, and containerized services (Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes).

**3. AI & Agentic Automation Transformation**
---------------------------------------------

* Actively drive the adoption of **Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent autonomous workflows** across the development and operational lifecycle.

* Identify repeat, recurring, and boilerplate engineering/operational tasks (e.g., automated code reviews, test generation, schema migrations, log analytics, incident triage) and architect multi-agent or prompt-engineered solutions to automate them.

* Foster a culture of AI-assisted engineering and experimentation within teams while strictly adhering to enterprise AI guardrails, security standards, and governance policies.

**4. Data Platform & Infrastructure Modernization**
---------------------------------------------------

* Oversee the architecture and optimization of high-throughput data and reporting pipelines leveraging relational engines (**Oracle 19c / OraaS**) and distributed document stores (**MongoDB 7.x/8.x / MaaS**).

* Design and govern high-volume event streaming and messaging fabrics utilizing **Apache Kafka and IBM MQ**.

* Ensure non-functional requirements (NFRs) such as high availability, fault tolerance, active-active failover, disaster recovery (RTO/RPO), and low-latency response times are rigorously met.
  

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 10-15 years of relevant experience in the Financial Service industry
* Experience as Applications Development Manager
* Experience as senior level in an Applications Development role
* Stakeholder and people management experience
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Proven project management skills
* Basic knowledge of industry practices and standards
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

title: Splunk Platform Architect
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Our team acts as a trusted technical partner for our customers, helping them navigate the complexities of hybrid and multi-cloud environments. We are a collaborative group of high performing data platform solution architects, positioned right at the intersection of our customers, field technical sellers, sellers and product teams. We value innovation, curiosity, and the open exchange of ideas with hunger to learn and make a difference. We believe the best solutions come from working together, and we pride ourselves on fostering a supportive environment where you can grow your expertise in AI and Splunk data architecture. If you’re a problem-solver who loves to share ideas, brings practical service provider (telecom) industry knowledge and delivers impactful results in the shape of technical business outcomes, we’d love to have you on the team.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As Splunk Platform Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical and strategic advisor to service provider leaders across the region. You will bridge complex telecommunications and network challenges with modern data platforms, observability, and AI to transform operations and monetize digital capabilities.
  
  

* Engage service provider executives and senior technical stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, operational challenges, and transformation goals. Explore areas of focus and uncover customer pain points. Once discovered, shape data and AI strategies for network operations, service assurance, customer experience, automation, security, and business operations.
* Design and communicate solution architectures spanning telemetry, observability, security data, network data, enterprise data platforms, analytics, and AI.
* Translate complex service provider challenges into practical platform strategies, solution architecture and working prototypes.
* Demonstrate how data platforms such as Splunk can help organisations improve visibility, reduce operational complexity, accelerate incident response, and enable data-driven decisions.
* Work closely with account teams, sales specialists, solution engineers, customer success, professional services, partners, and product teams.
* Enable field teams and customers through workshops, executive briefings, architecture sessions, demonstrations, and industry engagements.
* Identify repeatable patterns and differentiated use cases across various domains including 5G, cloud, OSS/BSS, network automation, observability, cybersecurity, and customer experience.
* Work with service providers to identify, shape, and solution API monetisation services. Connect business opportunities to architectures that expose network and digital capabilities through APIs, and consider the supporting data, analytics, security, integration, and operational requirements needed to deliver customer and partner value.
* Contribute to thought leadership through customer presentations, white papers, industry forums, and events such as TM Forum and Mobile World Congress.
* Bring external market, technology, and customer insights back into business strategy, solution development, and field enablement.

**Success Measures:**  

* Establishing trusted relationships with senior service provider stakeholders.
* Creating differentiated data and AI architecture strategies, designs, use cases and prototypes that address real operational and business challenges.
* Influencing customer adoption of modern data platform capabilities.
* Enabling account teams and partners to have stronger, more strategic customer conversations.
* Building repeatable service provider use cases and architecture patterns that can be rolled out to others.
* Strengthening the organisation’s position as a thought leader in service provider data-driven transformation.

The ideal candidate can move comfortably from a product discussion to an industry conversation to an enterprise data and transformation strategy-design and should be able to build prototypes when needed.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 12+ years experience in the telecommunications or service provider industry, with credibility across network, cloud, operations, assurance, automation, security, or customer experience domains.
* Deep experience in one or two service provider domains, combined with a sound working understanding of the others. Relevant domains include fixed wireline, wireless, mobile core, RAN, packet core, optical, transport/IP, 5G, network functions virtualization, cloud-native networking, OSS/BSS, network automation, and service assurance.
* The ability to communicate effectively with service provider executives, enterprise architects, network architects, NOC/SOC leaders, operations teams, and engineering organizations.
* Experience developing or influencing complex solution architectures in large-scale, multi-domain environments, and the ability to connect business outcomes and operational challenges to platform capabilities and architecture decisions.
* A strong understanding of data platforms, data architecture, telemetry, observability, analytics, AI, or security data solutions. Experience with Splunk or other enterprise data, observability, analytics, cloud, or security platforms is valuable.
* Knowledge of Cisco and other technologies and architectures relevant to service providers, as well as an understanding of autonomous and agentic architectures.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Strong executive handling, consulting skills, storytelling ability, and confidence leading strategic customer conversations. Experience working across sales, presales, product, engineering, delivery, and customer success teams is valuable.
* A curious, collaborative, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to operate across strategic and technical conversations.
* Experience advising customers on platform adoption, operating models, data governance, or transformation roadmaps. A background in enterprise architecture, consulting, technical sales, solution architecture, or senior customer advisory roles is valuable.
* Familiarity with TM Forum frameworks, Open APIs, industry standards, or service provider transformation programmes.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Process Manager - Monitoring & Event Management
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

As the **Monitoring & Event Management Process Manager**, you will provide hands-on technical leadership and direction for enterprise monitoring, observability, and event-management practice. You will assess existing practices and operational maturity, identify gaps and risks, and define a practical improvement roadmap aligned with business-critical service requirements.

You will collaborate with IT service owners, architects, operations and engineering teams, Incident and Problem Management teams, Cybersecurity, and external service providers.

Your primary responsibility will be to define and document monitoring practices and guidelines, while introducing or supporting the enhancement of forward-looking monitoring solutions for IT services using modern technologies such as AI. These efforts should improve event quality, reduce alert noise, accelerate detection and recovery, enable predictive operations, and support safe automation.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Assess the maturity of current monitoring and event-management practices across processes, people, tools, data, governance, and operating models.
* Identify monitoring coverage gaps, architectural weaknesses, operational risks, recurring failure patterns, alert noise, manual toil, and barriers to effective service visibility.
* Define the target-state architecture, standards, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for monitoring, observability, event management, and AIOps.
* Lead the evaluation, selection, design, integration, and implementation of enterprise grade monitoring & observability solutions covering metrics, logs, traces, events, topology, and digital experience signals.
* Establish service-oriented monitoring by mapping applications, infrastructure, cloud services, dependencies, and configuration items to business services and service objectives.
* Improve event detection, severity models, thresholds, filtering, deduplication, enrichment, correlation, routing, escalation, and response workflows.
* Introduce AIOps use cases such as anomaly detection, event correlation, probable root-cause analysis, incident summarization, predictive insights, and assisted remediation.
* Integrate monitoring platforms with IT service-management, configuration-management, notification, collaboration, and automation solutions.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, proofs of concept, product evaluations, vendor engagements, and implementation projects from design through operational handover.
* Define governance, onboarding standards, operating procedures, support models, ownership, documentation, training, and compliance controls.
* Review monitoring outcomes and incident trends regularly, prioritize continual-improvement initiatives, and track benefits such as reduced alert volume, lower mean time to detect and recover, improved coverage, and increased automation.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in IT operations, DevOps, SRE, observability, monitoring, or platform engineering, including technical leadership or architecture responsibility.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, traces, events, synthetic monitoring, real-user monitoring, application performance monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, network monitoring, and service dependency mapping.
* Experience with enterprise observability and monitoring technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, SolarWinds, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, or comparable platforms.
* Practical knowledge of SRE principles, including service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, the four golden signals, reliability reviews, toil reduction, capacity planning, and blameless learning.
* Experience designing or implementing AIOps use cases using machine learning, analytics, or generative AI for anomaly detection, event correlation, root-cause support, prediction, automation, and incident assistance.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and hybrid infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, microservices, APIs, networking, security, and resilient distributed-system architecture.
* Automation and scripting capability using Python, PowerShell, Bash, REST APIs, webhooks, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and CI/CD practices.
Working knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly Monitoring & Event Management, Incident Management, Availability Management, Capacity & Performance Management, and Continual Improvement.  

**Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications in SRE, DevOps, cloud architecture, Kubernetes, ITIL, observability, ServiceNow, or enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms for operational telemetry, including scalable storage, stream processing, and data-quality governance.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and managed-service providers in complex enterprise environments.

**Key Competencies**

* SRE and DevOps Technical Leadership
* Enterprise Monitoring and Observability Architecture
* Monitoring & Event Management Process Governance
* AIOps Strategy and Responsible Automation
* Operational Maturity Assessment and Road mapping
* Program Delivery, Vendor Management, and Stakeholder Influence
* Data-Driven Continual Improvement and Benefits Realization

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Staff Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform**

**OpenSearch Must-Have | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Redis | Capacity Engineering | Automation**

**Level**

Staff DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead)

**Domain**

Distributed Data Platforms

**Primary Focus**

Cross-team architecture and systemic reliability for OpenSearch-centered data platforms, with Kafka, Redis, capacity engineering, and Python automation

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Staff DBRE with deep OpenSearch/Elasticsearch expertise and strong distributed-systems judgment. The role leads high-impact architecture, reliability, performance, scalability, capacity, and lifecycle improvements across major data-platform services, complemented by Kafka, Redis, Linux, observability, and Python automation.

The Staff DBRE solves ambiguous cross-team problems, establishes reusable platform patterns, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple engineering groups. The scope extends beyond a single cluster or incident while remaining hands-on and evidence-driven.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Staff DBRE is a senior individual-contributor technical leadership role focused on solving ambiguous, high-impact reliability and architecture problems across platforms and teams. The role has broad influence within the data-platform domain, while enterprise-wide cross-domain strategy remains a Principal-level responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns complex cross-team reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, architecture, and operational-maturity problems across major OpenSearch-centered platform services.

**Technical Depth**

Serves as a domain authority in OpenSearch and distributed-systems failure modes, with strong supporting depth in Kafka, Redis, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking.

**Engineering Leadership**

Defines platform-domain patterns, mentors Senior and Lead engineers, raises design-review and incident-analysis rigor, and influences adjacent teams.

**Automation Architecture**

Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts.

**Execution**

Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes.

**Organizational Influence**

Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. OpenSearch Platform Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns.
* Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems.
* Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment.

**B. Kafka and Redis Reliability**
----------------------------------

* Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services.
* Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability.

**C. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention.
* Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability.

**D. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain.
* Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations.
* Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope.
* Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture.
* Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes.
* Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior.
* Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment.
* Strong incident leadership, written communication, mentoring, and design-review skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Experience with both Kafka and Redis at meaningful production scale.
* Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services.
* Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies.
* Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, capacity, lifecycle, and operational-maturity baselines for critical data-platform services and lead material improvements.
* Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams.
* Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards.
* Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is exercised through technical influence and mentorship.
* This is not a coordination-only role; the Staff DBRE must remain hands-on and capable of deep technical investigation.
* This role does not replace ownership held by application, SRE, infrastructure, network, storage, or cloud teams.
* This is not a ticket-queue role limited to incident response and routine operations; systemic improvement is expected.
* This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Director,DBRE
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**The Opportunity**
===================

Qualys runs one of the largest and most complex data platforms in the enterprise security industry — a massive Oracle and Exadata estate at the core, surrounded by a self-managed open-source big data fabric: Kafka, Hadoop, Cassandra, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes. These systems directly underpin the product SLAs we deliver to 10,000+ customers worldwide.

We are looking for a Director of Database Reliability Engineering who combines deep technical craft with the leadership instinct to scale a team and the builder's mindset to ship systems that eliminate toil. You don't have to be the world's leading expert in every technology on the stack — but you must carry genuine depth in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem, and the intellectual range to go deep where the situation demands it. We do not expect day-one mastery across every system; we expect depth in core areas and the proven ability to rapidly develop expertise where the platform needs it.

This role directly owns database platform operations and reliability practices, and influences adjacent infrastructure and application teams through technical credibility and cross-functional partnership. You will lead a team of ~30, serve as the final technical escalation point for the data platform, and shape the multi-year strategy for how Qualys builds, automates, and evolves its data infrastructure.

**Core Focus Areas**
====================

This is a wide-scope role. Here is how candidates should prioritize their self-evaluation:

**01** **Oracle + Distributed Systems Technical Depth** — Deep in one, strong across the other — enough to lead architecture and hold the team accountable

**02** **Data Platform Reliability & Incident Ownership** — SLOs, escalation authority, DR, predictive capacity — the foundational mandate

**03** **AI-Driven Automation & Toil Elimination** — Building and shipping agents, not just evaluating tools — measurable impact on MTTR and operational load

**04** **Team Leadership & Org Development** — Managing ~30 across ICs and managers; building culture, career ladders, and hiring bar

**05** **Vendor Management & Cost Optimization** — Oracle relationship, licensing discipline, and infrastructure cost efficiency

**What Makes This Role Unique**
===============================

* **Breadth of scope, depth of ownership** — You hold the charter for Oracle/Exadata AND the full open-source big data stack — accountable for reliability across all of it
* **Build AI systems, not just use them** — We expect shipped production tooling — AI agents, autonomous remediation, intelligent observability — not proof-of-concept demos
* **Strategy and execution in equal measure** — You will define the multi-year data platform roadmap and then make it happen — this is not a pure operations role
* **Real cross-functional influence** — Data reliability touches every product team; this role earns authority through technical credibility, not org chart position
* **A platform worth modernizing** — Battle-tested at scale, with genuine complexity — and a leadership team committed to doing it right

**What You Will Build**
=======================

Beyond running the platform, we expect this leader to leave a concrete engineering footprint. Examples of the systems we want this role to build and own:

* **AI-assisted incident triage system** — LLM-powered log analysis and alert summarization that cuts triage time from minutes to seconds
* **Autonomous remediation agents** — Self-healing workflows for common failure patterns — space exhaustion, replication lag, lock contention, consumer group lag — with safe human escalation fallback
* **Natural-language operational query interface** — Engineers ask questions in plain English; the system queries metrics, logs, and configuration state to answer
* **Predictive capacity and anomaly models** — ML-driven forecasting for Oracle tablespace growth, Kafka partition pressure, and Cassandra compaction backlog
* **Reliability-as-code pipeline gates** — Automated schema review, load test, and regression detection integrated into CI/CD so reliability issues are caught before production

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Own the Data Platform Reliability Charter**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and drive SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across Oracle, Exadata, Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes-hosted data services
* Serve as the final technical escalation point for all P0/P1 incidents; lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent resolution — not workarounds
* Own disaster recovery architecture, backup integrity standards, and data durability SLAs — validated through regular DR exercises
* Establish predictive capacity planning and performance baselines across the full data platform footprint
* Drive cost efficiency and infrastructure utilization optimization — right-sizing resources, eliminating idle capacity, and building chargeback/showback visibility for leadership

**Define and Execute the Multi-Year Data Platform Strategy**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and own a multi-year DBRE roadmap — covering reliability targets, modernization priorities, platform consolidation opportunities, and AI automation milestones
* Drive platform evolution decisions: when to standardize, when to consolidate, when to retire, and when to invest in new capabilities
* Provide architectural guidance for major data platform initiatives — schema design, topology changes, new technology adoption, and migration planning
* Partner with Product Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure leadership to embed reliability and cost constraints into platform direction from day one

**Go Deep on Oracle and Exadata**
---------------------------------

* Carry deep technical authority for Oracle Database (19c+), RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, and Exadata — sufficient to lead architecture reviews, diagnose production incidents, and hold senior engineers accountable
* Drive query optimization, AWR/ASH-based diagnostics, execution plan analysis, and schema design reviews for mission-critical OLTP and analytical workloads
* Manage Oracle vendor relationships with technical and commercial depth: negotiate support contracts, challenge licensing interpretations, escalate through Oracle's senior channels, and ensure Qualys negotiates from a position of knowledge
* Own Oracle licensing compliance end-to-end — a material financial and risk area requiring both engineering precision and commercial acumen
* Lead Exadata patching cadence, storage cell failure playbooks, IORM policy tuning, and hardware lifecycle planning

**Lead the Open-Source Big Data Platform**
------------------------------------------

* Architect and operate Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, and Ceph deployments — self-managed at scale, not cloud-managed services
* Apply strong distributed systems fundamentals — consensus and replication models, storage I/O patterns, network latency sensitivity, and horizontal scaling — to architectural decisions that hold under load
* Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering on Kubernetes-native stateful workloads: operators, persistent volumes, storage class optimization, and capacity planning
* Drive standardization of runbooks, alerting, and operational playbooks across all technologies — documented, automated, no tribal knowledge

**Build AI-Powered Reliability Systems**
----------------------------------------

* Design and ship AI agents that automate tier-1 database operational toil — systems running in production with measurable impact on MTTR and alert noise
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) into operational workflows for log triage, incident summarization, runbook execution, and anomaly-triggered decision support
* Evaluate AIOps platforms and observability tooling with engineering rigor — quantify the actual value, not the vendor pitch
* Embed reliability-by-design upstream: schema review gates, load test automation, and database performance regression detection in CI/CD pipelines

**Lead and Develop the DBRE Team**
----------------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and develop ~30 DBAs, SREs, and data platform engineers across individual contributors and engineering managers
* Define hiring standards, career ladders, and team structure that attract and retain senior database and reliability talent
* Build a culture of technical rigor, blameless learning, and relentless automation — where manual toil is a bug, not a process
* Eliminate single points of knowledge failure through documentation, cross-training, and disciplined on-call rotation design
* Own workforce planning: headcount forecasting, skills gap analysis, and building specialist sub-teams as the platform evolves

**How We Measure Success**
==========================

* **Platform Availability** — SLO attainment across all data services — reduction in unplanned production incidents attributable to DBRE gaps
* **MTTA / MTTR** — Measurable improvement in time to detect and resolve incidents, accelerated by AI tooling
* **Automation Coverage** — Percentage of tier-1 operational tasks eliminated through shipped agents and tooling
* **Cost Efficiency** — Infrastructure utilization rates, Oracle licensing optimization, and idle/over-provisioned resource reduction
* **Team Health & Retention** — On-call load reduction, career growth trajectory, and senior IC/manager retention
* **Platform Strategy Execution** — Multi-year roadmap milestones delivered; capacity forecasts validated against actual growth

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Must Have**
-------------

* 15+ years in database engineering, reliability engineering, or data platform operations — with 5+ years leading multi-person teams including at least one layer of managers
* Deep expertise in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem (Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, Kubernetes)
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals — replication and consensus models, storage I/O, network latency tradeoffs, and scaling patterns for stateful workloads — applied to real production decisions
* Shipped operational tooling or agents using LLM APIs with measurable impact (MTTR reduction, toil elimination, alert noise reduction) — production systems, not proofs of concept
* Oracle vendor relationship management — commercial negotiation, license compliance ownership, and technical escalation through Oracle's support and sales organizations
* Infrastructure cost control — hands-on experience right-sizing compute and storage, eliminating idle capacity, and building cost visibility (chargeback/showback) across database infrastructure
* Track record leading teams of 15+ engineers with both IC and manager-level reports; experience growing technical talent and building hiring bars
* Executive communication skills — translating database risk, reliability posture, and investment needs to C-suite audiences with clarity and commercial grounding
* Experience serving as final escalation point for production data platform incidents — with the technical depth to diagnose, direct, and close

**Strong Plus**
---------------

* Exadata-specific depth: IORM policy tuning, smart scan diagnostics, storage server failure recovery, and hardware lifecycle decision-making
* Kubernetes-native data platform experience with stateful workload operators (Strimzi, Cassandra Operator, OpenSearch Operator, Redis Operator)
* Experience with AIOps or observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) including custom exporter and agent development
* Familiarity with agentic integration patterns (MCP, tool-use APIs) for building AI-augmented operational toolchains
* Hands-on coding in Python, Go, or shell scripting — enough to design and ship internal tooling independently
* Background in security or compliance-adjacent industries where data integrity and auditability carry regulatory weight

**Who This Role Is For**
========================

This role is for a data platform leader who still gets pulled in by a gnarly execution plan, and who sees a recurring on-call alert as a signal that something needs to be built — then builds it. You lead by doing as much as by directing, and your team follows you because they know you have sat in their chair.

You hold Oracle's feet to the fire in a negotiation and hold your engineers to a high bar in a design review. You speak reliability to a DBA and business risk to a CFO. You don't wait to be handed a mandate — you see the gap, take the charter, and grow the team around it. You balance operating rigorously today with shaping the platform for where the business will be in three years.

If you are energized by owning something truly foundational — the data layer that everything else at Qualys depends on — and you want to build the next generation of AI-driven reliability engineering, we would like to hear from you.

**This Role Is Not For**
------------------------

* DBAs focused on ticket-based operations who are not comfortable driving architectural decisions and organizational change
* Leaders who are not hands-on in production systems — this role requires genuine technical engagement, not just team management
* Candidates whose AI experience is limited to tool adoption — we need operators who have shipped agents and measured the impact
* Candidates who need full-stack mastery on day one — we value depth in core areas and intellectual range over checklist coverage

**About Qualys**

Qualys, Inc. (NASDAQ: QLYS) is a pioneer and leading provider of disruptive cloud-based security, compliance, and IT solutions with more than 10,000 subscription customers worldwide, including a majority of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100. Qualys helps organizations streamline and automate their security and compliance solutions onto a single platform for greater agility, better business outcomes, and substantial cost savings.
